---
name: Feature or design proposal
about: Discuss a generic capability, refactor or documentation improvement
---

## Problem and use case
What user-visible problem needs solving? Link related roadmap items/issues.

## Proposed boundary
Which APIs change? What is explicitly out of scope?

## Alternatives and evidence
How do existing systems address this? What trade-offs or measurements inform this?
Avoid dataset-specific execution shortcuts.

## Acceptance criteria
Correctness, errors/limits, compatibility/recovery, performance and documentation
checks as applicable. Identify dependencies and unresolved questions.
